title: Landing-page bundle pointer (current.json) v1
description: The single mutable object in the published artifact layout (parent EPIC_PLAN §5). Swapped atomically via same-dir rename(). mss ignores any pointer whose `version` is <= its active version; rollback is a new higher `version` referencing the previous good bundle_id. Also carries the signed, monotonic kill-list (parent §6.1).

manifest_url.description: Relative-to-artifact-root or absolute URL of the manifest.json this pointer activates.

version.description: Monotonic. mss rejects any pointer with version <= active.

previous_bundle_id.description: The bundle this one supersedes (for audit / rollback target).

signature.description: ed25519 signature over (manifest_sha256 + version) (+ disabled_variants when present).

disabled_variants.description: Signed, monotonic, auditable kill-list keyed on the canonical (site, purpose, slug, num) tuple. NOT a second policy language (parent §6.1).

site.description: Canonical SITE id or '*' for all.

replacement_num.description: NUM to redirect/serve instead; omit for safe-fallback render.
